worldcombat.skill.razorshell.summary: Flash the shell edge and sweep its thin outer rim across a crescent in front: only targets standing in the rim's thickness band are cut, while the inner ring against the body is left alone. Every cut target has a chance to lose a Defence stage, and the watery edge soaks whoever it cuts. The Full-Moon style sweeps wider and shaves more often; the Keen-Edge style narrows the crescent and hits harder per target, with the same rim thickness.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.description: Sweeps a crescent rim in front over 4 ticks; every enemy on the blade takes one cut of about %1$s contact damage, up to %2$s targets.
Centred on the user the blade travels along an arc of %1$s blocks radius through %2$s degrees with a rim thickness of %3$s blocks; only bodies inside that outer band are cut, the inner ring is safe.

A landed cut has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Defence by %2$s stage(s); it also leaves a soaked mark on the target for %3$s that Water and Ice moves can read (a target already soaked is not re-timed), and pushes it %4$s blocks outward along the arc.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.wide.on: Full-Moon style: a wider crescent, a higher shave chance, a longer soak and a stronger push, at the cost of ×0.88 per hit and +6 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.wide.off: Keen-Edge style: a narrower crescent, but ×1.15 per hit, a shorter cooldown and a slightly lower shave chance - better against a single target.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.growth.0: From level %1$s the carve rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.growth.1: From level %1$s the carve rises to %2$s and the shave chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.use.0: Cut the front rank with the outer rim at a fixed distance
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.use.1: Shave the Defence off a whole rank of foes
worldcombat.skill.razorshell.use.2: Soak everyone it cuts, leaving a wet window for other moves
